rejectedPairs.reason: Cannot positively approve abominate as an ordinary learner-facing literal equivalent; highly literary/low-confidence English choice.

Abstain normally corresponds to reflexive abstenerse; bare abstener does not preserve the ordinary construction.
Acaecer means happen/occur, not become; also event-subject restrictions need special handling.
Involve is not an ordinary literal equivalent of carry/entail and can change the argument relation.
Ordinary acechar is stalk/lie in wait; threaten is context-dependent rather than a literal default.
Remember normally needs acordarse de; bare acordar ordinarily means agree/decide.
Remind is not an ordinary unrestricted equivalent of bare acordar; reflexive/causative construction differs.
Acuciar is urge/press; hasten needs a different causative/complement construction.
Adhere generally requires an intransitive/reflexive reading, while transitive adherir means attach; no unrestricted mapping approved.
Happen is event-subject restricted and does not support the generated personal readings of advenir.

Await/wait is reliable; expect is a context-dependent interpretation not positively approved here.
Hope adds a wish reading not ordinarily guaranteed by await/wait.
Bustle is intransitive; ajetrear usually agitates/bustles someone or is reflexive. Argument mapping is not reliably preserved.
Dawn is impersonal in the ordinary weather/time sense; renderer has no it-only specialization.
Manage requires an added infinitival-success construction; bare reach/achieve is safer.
Range is not an ordinary reliable learner equivalent of align.
